name: marketing-copy
description: Write outbound promotional copy for a product or project: launch and update posts for community platforms and social media, store page descriptions and short blurbs, landing page headlines and calls to action, press-style announcements, and the naming of a product for another language or market. Covers what may be disclosed publicly, keeping claims traceable to shipped changes, and writing a headline that carries information instead of hype. Use when drafting or revising anything aimed at people
author: scarletkc
summary_zh: 帮助为产品或项目撰写可信的对外宣传文案，适合发布动态、商店介绍、落地页、新闻稿及海外市场命名。
